Their reference marginals may differ. Here Umegaki D(A||B)=Tr[A(log A-log B)], with value +infinity when the support condition fails. For finite descriptions of rational-complex strictly positive POVM pairs on a common input,with variable input dimension and outcome counts,complete SLD dominance is coRE-complete and its failure is RE-complete. For every finite-dimensional channel pair,complete SLD order is equivalent to unrestricted complete Umegaki order over all finite references and all input-state pairs. No total computable function of a valid rational POVM pair bounds a reference dimension sufficient to witness every complete-SLD failure.
